name: value-utilities/escape-comma-in-arbitrary
description: Selector escaping for arbitrary values with embedded commas. Tailwind's pipeline runs `cssesc` (CSS identifier escape) followed by `escapeCommas` which substitutes `\,` for `\2c ` (with trailing space — a `\2c` not followed by space/non-hex parses as U+02C0). The substitution must happen AFTER the cssesc post-pass (`collapse_hex_escape_spaces`); otherwise the `\2c ` trailing space gets stripped when followed by `\.2` and the resulting `\2c\.2` is malformed. Surfaced by `before:shadow-[0_2px_5px_rgba(0,_0,_0,_.2)]` in horizon-tailwind-react.
